# 3 bed semi-detached house for sale

> Michael Pigott Auctioneer & Valuer is delighted to present for sale this lovely 3 bedroom semi-detached property situated in a prime & mature residential area in Farranree. The property occupies a corner plot which offers lots of space especially to the front with a spacious enclosed front garden with secure off street parking.

## Fakta
- Typ: semi-detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 61.1 m²
- Energetická náročnost: G
- Lokalita: 143 Saint Brendan's Road, Farranree
- Cena: 235 000 €
